question: In a certain code language, ‘HAPPY’ is written as ‘JCRRA’ and ‘MAGIC’ is written as ‘OCIKE’. How will ‘LEVEL’ be written in that language?
solution:
**Explanation:**

The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Letters are increased by +2 in following manner.

 
• In HAPPY → JCRRA 
 
 
• .​​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d54058b6f80189a5b65be3c96aa3995a6216aac71880ff0cb67d949f5c7e8ecb.png] 
 
 

 

 
• In MAGIC → OCIKE ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70ebb9b1eaa2900e23a3d580a6c734721ca4cdfc1b3cf204ac57f912085bf7c2.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In LEVEL → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c63aa7ebe84d6e5d31b2122ca85eeec74405e5f1c93a3a1c663242734c64ed1.png] 
 
 

We get 'NGXGN'.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
